data.title: Manta Bay
data.about:
Manta Bay by Major Development is an extraordinary new residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, offering an extraordinary Maldivian-inspired lifestyle. Inspired by stingrays, the design seamlessly integrates modern architecture with the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape. It features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments with 5-star hotel services.

Each residence boasts spacious layouts, large windows, and premium Italian brand finishes, ensuring that almost every apartment enjoys stunning views and access to a private terrace. Manta Bay Marjan Island apartments also features direct beach access, with golf carts available to transport residents to the beach and the nearby Wynn Resort. With its prime location on Al Marjan Island, a popular destination for tourists and residents alike, Manta Bay is poised to become a highly sought-after property investment.

characteristics_module.title: Redefine Waterfront Living with Unmatched Luxury and Lucrative Returns at Manta Bay.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Almost every apartment offers gorgeous views and access to a private terrace.
  • Unparalleled living experience with the world's highest rooftop beach, featuring real sand and seawater.
  • Maldivian-inspired architecture, with a design that seamlessly integrates modern elements and natural beauty.
  • A luxurious lobby that creates a lasting first impression, setting the tone for the entire development.
  • Panoramic elevators provide residents with stunning, uninterrupted views of the entire community.
  • 80% of the complex has exquisite plants, creating a lush, green environment.
  • Flexible payment plans for Manta Bay waterfront properties are available, with just a 5% down payment. 
  • Flexible payment plan options and the possibility of securing a mortgage upon handover. Units can be sold after completing 40% of the payment plan.
  • A property value increase of 20-25% annually is anticipated over the next 3 years, followed by a projected annual increase of 10-15% thereafter.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Proximity to Top-Notch Hotels and Attractions on Al Marjan Island.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The premium residential complex by Major Development is located on Al Marjan Island.  The stunning man-made archipelago consists of four interconnected islets: Breeze Island, Dream Island, Treasure Island, and View Island. Known for its pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters, Al Marjan Island is a premier destination for luxury living and tourism. The island’s unique charm, combined with the planned developments, such as the largest casino in the world, positions it as a key player in the future of Ras Al Khaimah’s real estate and tourism sectors.

Next to Wynn Al Marjan Island Resort
11 Minutes to Al Hamra Mall
15 Minutes to Al Hamra Golf Club
30 Minutes Ras Al Khaimah International Airport
65 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
70 Minutes Drive to Downtown Dubai

more_info.question: What are the payment options for purchasing a unit at Manta Bay?

more_info.answer: Yes, Manta Bay is a promising investment opportunity due to its unique features, prime location, and high rental income potential. The project is expected to yield 20-30% per annum, making it an attractive choice for investors looking to capitalize on the booming real estate market in Ras Al Khaimah.
more_info.question: Is Manta Bay a good investment opportunity?

more_info.answer: Residents of Manta Bay can enjoy a range of premium amenities, including the rooftop beach, panoramic elevators, luxurious lobby, and continuous golf cart transportation to the beach and nearby casino. The development is also surrounded by lush landscaping and offers direct beach access.
more_info.question: What amenities are available at Manta Bay?

more_info.answer: Manta Bay is just a 5-minute drive from what will be the largest casino in the world, making it a convenient location for those seeking entertainment and leisure options. The development is also situated on Al Marjan Island, a popular destination for residents and tourists alike.
